regime_context: The detector shows a broad, trend-following leadership in Precious Metals with Gold Miners (XGD.TO) the clear leader, Silver & Royalties challenging, and Base Metals/Copper crowded but still eligible. The validated edge here is risk control from the absolute-trend gate, not return forecasting, and track record shows only 55.6% hit rate with weak directional accuracy (0.278), so conviction should stay low. Macro narrative is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines, but that is coincident market-level context only.
emerging_watch: Watching Silver & Royalties: if it holds rank 2 with breadth 1.0 and its durability_bar rises above 0.80, while Gold Miners' margin over it narrows below 0.20, I would consider it a confirmed handoff candidate worth a separate lean.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead the ranks with the highest durability_bar (0.82), a clean 'trend' hurst_tag, full breadth (1.0), and a non-crowded reading. The absolute-trend gate validates this as eligible, suggesting staying power rather than a mean-revert setup. This is a focus lens, not a return forecast, but the trend-health legs (durability, breadth, hurst) are the strongest in the universe.
theses.dissent: Precious metals leadership can be driven by geopolitical headlines (macro shows geopolitical as a dominant theme) that reverse quickly, and the detector's own rank-IC is near zero — this may simply be where attention is, not where return will come from.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper ranks 3rd but carries a crowded flag (crowding_z 1.11, crowded true) with a 'mixed' hurst_tag. The crowding flag is a size-down caution only, not a short, but combined with trend-health that is less clean than Gold/Silver, it argues for not adding here while crowding is elevated.
theses.dissent: Base metals could be the next leg of a commodities supercycle, and crowding is coincident, not predictive — avoiding it may miss continuation.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO outperforms XGD.TO by 8% before the check-by date while remaining non-crowded.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology ranks last (16th) with the most negative score, yet the macro narrative is dominated by AI/tech headlines — a classic attention-heavy, flow-weak setup. The detector shows crowded (crowding_z 1.12), 'mixed' hurst_tag, and negative eligibility. The guardrail explicitly warns not to treat thematic attention spikes as a buy; here the narrative is loud but the trend-health is poor.
theses.dissent: AI/tech is the dominant macro narrative; if unscheduled geopolitical surprises fade, tech could re-rate sharply as the headline narrative finally meets price.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO rises into the top 5 of the ranks before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
